annotationFindings.message: #(preaggregate) on measure "total" of source "zoned" is not built, so the measure is served live: the source sets its own time zone (`timezone: 'America/New_York'`), and a query on it is never read from a rollup, whose stored times would be read in another zone, nor through a join (no source in the same zone joins it), so its table would cost a build no query reads.
